envtech.name: OECD ENV-TECH
envtech.source: Haščič, I. & Migotto, M. (2015). Measuring environmental innovation using patent data. OECD Environment Working Papers 89. https://doi.org/10.1787/5js009kf48xw-en
envtech.build: scripts/build_envtech.py (raw/env_tech.xlsx, transcribed from the paper's annex)
envtech.notes: Codes like Y02T10/72-7291 are CPC subgroup ranges kept as code/code_to; 3 rows are conditional combinations (code_type=complex). Verified against the original annex (Haščič & Migotto 2015, ENV/EPOC/WPEI(2014)6/FINAL): every code token matches except two entries missing from the spreadsheet (Y02E60/70-7892, Y02T10/10), now added by build_envtech.py. Topic assignment of each code was not re-verified.

jee_srivastav.name: Jee & Srivastav clean/grey/dirty
jee_srivastav.source: Jee, S. J. & Srivastav, S. (2023/24). Pivoting from Dirty to Clean: The Intellectual Distance between Clean and Dirty Technologies, Supplementary Table 1. Lists transcribed from Rozendaal (2024), Table E1.
jee_srivastav.notes: Grey is removed from clean; patents both clean and dirty are excluded in the original analysis. Journal reference/DOI still to be added.

y02.name: CPC Y02/Y04S tagging scheme
y02.source: EPO/CPC Y02 and Y04S tagging scheme.
y02.notes: Nine subclass codes (Y02A-Y02W, Y04S); each covers all groups and subgroups below it, so no deeper tree is needed to flag Y02/Y04S patents. EPO status of all sections: December 2021 (https://www.epo.org/en/news-events/in-focus/classification/classification/updatesYO2andY04S, page text supplied by the user). Use codes like Y02E10/70 only via the Jee & Srivastav sector breakdown.

ipc_gi.name: WIPO IPC Green Inventory
ipc_gi.source: WIPO IPC Green Inventory (2022 list), expanded and checked against PATSTAT by Favot, M., Vesnic, L., Priore, R., Bincoletto, A., Morea, F. (2023). Green patents and green codes: how different methodologies lead to different results. Resources, Conservation & Recycling Advances 200132. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rcradv.2023.200132 ; data/code https://gitlab.com/area-science-park-sustainability/green-patents (CC-BY-4.0)
ipc_gi.notes: 1,214 codes, 170 leaf topics with topic_1/topic_2 hierarchy. Cross-check: S. Chen's list (github.com/shuangchenfinance/greenpatent) expands ranges numerically and differs substantially (553 codes in common, 661 only Favot, 405 only Chen); Favot is used because it is validated against real IPC symbols.

envtech_expanded.name: OECD ENV-TECH, ranges expanded
envtech_expanded.source: Haščič & Migotto (2015), expanded per topic by Favot, M., Vesnic, L., Priore, R., Bincoletto, A., Morea, F. (2023). Green patents and green codes: how different methodologies lead to different results. Resources, Conservation & Recycling Advances 200132. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rcradv.2023.200132 ; data/code https://gitlab.com/area-science-park-sustainability/green-patents (CC-BY-4.0)
envtech_expanded.notes: 3,150 unique codes in 4,525 topic-code rows; one code can belong to several topics. Use envtech.csv for the original range notation.

dechezlepretre_martin_mohnen.name: Dechezleprêtre, Martin & Mohnen (2013) clean / less-dirty / dirty
dechezlepretre_martin_mohnen.source: Dechezleprêtre, A., Martin, R., Mohnen, M. (2013). Knowledge spillovers from clean and dirty technologies: a patent citation analysis. CCCEP WP 151 / Grantham Research Institute WP 135.
dechezlepretre_martin_mohnen.notes: Four sectors: car, fuel, energy, lighting; 'less dirty' = grey. Transcribed from the three-column Figure 2; printed typo B06K6 corrected to B60K6; E02B in the energy-dirty column kept as printed. This is NOT the 'Dechezleprêtre et al. (2021)' cited by Jee & Srivastav.

aghion_benabou_martin_roulet.name: Aghion, Bénabou, Martin & Roulet (2021) auto sector
aghion_benabou_martin_roulet.source: Aghion, P., Bénabou, R., Martin, R., Roulet, A. (2021). Environmental preferences and technological choices: Is market competition clean or dirty? NBER WP 28634; AER: Insights 5(1), 2023. Appendix Table A1.
aghion_benabou_martin_roulet.notes: Auto sector only (Y02T, F02, B60). NOT the Aghion et al. (2016, JPE) paper; its grey Y02T10 codes differ from the Jee & Srivastav grey list.
